grammatical_complexity.notes: Dominated by past simple with frequent past perfect (6-7 instances) and several relative clauses. Conditionals and modals appear as a noticeable minority. Roughly 25-30% of sentences contain level-3+ structures.

cultural_reference_load.notes: Most references are globally known or understandable from context. 'Sunday brunches' is mildly North American but inferable. Virgin Mary is well known in LatAm Catholic culture. No deeply unfamiliar customs.

sentence_structure.notes: Mix of very short dialogue lines and longer narrative sentences. Some sentences with multiple noun phrases and subordinate clauses (e.g., the list of thoughts about pregnancy). Average around 14 words but with notable variety.
